item.title: Alaska Science Forum Time capsule: Color guard
item.description: Note: Regardless of how far they had advanced into autumn colors, all the leaves in Goldstream Valley on the morning of Sept. 3, 2026, were crusted with frost. Neither green willow nor purple fireweed leaves were spared, a first-frost possibility that Carla Helfferich explores in this week’s Alaska Science Forum time capsule from Sept. 11, 1997. Helfferich was the primary author for the forum from 1988 to 1994, when she hired Ned Rozell as her successor.

item.title: Bryan Norcross: The Atlantic rests while the Pacific keeps cranking out tropical systems
item.description: The atmospheric environment over the Caribbean and the tropical Atlantic continues to be hostile to any systems that are in a position to develop.
